display.purpose: H1 of /v docs, page titles. Real foundry-weight not flat-scale large.

headline.purpose: H2s, section dividers in operator chrome.

title.purpose: Row labels, button text, form section headers.

body.purpose: Article prose and form help text. Capped at 65ch (Reading) or 80ch (Full).

label.purpose: Section eyebrows, kind tags, surface stamps, kbd hints. Always uppercase, letter-spaced.

mono.purpose: Slugs, dates, kbd hints, footer micro-type. The receipt voice.

code.purpose: Inline code and Shiki-rendered code blocks.

shadows.name: tactile-input
shadows.purpose: Persistent on text inputs and textareas. Reads like a printed underline rather than a drop shadow.

shadows.name: press
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons on :active. Softer than the default browser press.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Two-step outline (paper offset + ochre ring). Identical for keyboard and mouse focus.

shadows.name: tooltip-soft
shadows.purpose: Watermark tooltips and the cmd-palette modal. The only floating-overlay shadow.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions on chrome (hover, focus, press).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Snappier-finish easing for entrance/disclosure (cmd-palette open, outline reveal, watermark underline-draw).

breakpoints.name: outline
breakpoints.purpose: Outline panel auto-shows at this width and above.

components.name: Watermark Glyph
components.description: The signature mark. Universal corner glyph with click-to-reveal tooltip menu. W1 underline-draw on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-watermark" aria-label="Open menu"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 19V5l5 7 5-7v14"/><path d="M16 5l5 14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-watermark { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(95% 0.008 145); border: 1px solid oklch(85% 0.012 140); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: visible; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); padding: 0; } .ds-watermark::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: -7px; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 0; height: 2px; background: oklch(64% 0.14 85); transition: width 280ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-watermark:hover { border-color: oklch(64% 0.14 85); } .ds-watermark:hover::after { width: 100%; } .ds-watermark svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: oklch(64% 0.14 85); } .ds-watermark:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(95% 0.008 145), 0 0 0 4px oklch(64% 0.14 85); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-watermark::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Toolbar Button
components.description: Icon-only square button. Used in the reader toolbar (outline toggle), and as the floating show-outline button.
components.html: <button class="ds-toolbar-btn ds-toolbar-btn--active" aria-label="Hide outline"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="4" y1="6" x2="20" y2="6"/><line x1="8" y1="12" x2="20" y2="12"/><line x1="12" y1="18" x2="20" y2="18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-toolbar-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(95% 0.008 145); border: 1px solid oklch(85% 0.012 140); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), background 220ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); padding: 0; } .ds-toolbar-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: oklch(48% 0.018 200); transition: color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-toolbar-btn:hover { border-color: oklch(64% 0.14 85); background: oklch(92% 0.012 140); } .ds-toolbar-btn:hover svg { color: oklch(64% 0.14 85); } .ds-toolbar-btn--active { background: oklch(64% 0.14 85); border-color: oklch(64% 0.14 85); } .ds-toolbar-btn--active svg { color: oklch(95% 0.008 145); } .ds-toolbar-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(95% 0.008 145), 0 0 0 4px oklch(64% 0.14 85); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Save / Submit / Create. The inverted-fill anchor of any form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(24% 0.014 240); color: oklch(95% 0.008 145); font-family: 'Inter Tight', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.005em; line-height: 1.3; padding: 9px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(54% 0.16 80); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(95% 0.008 145), 0 0 0 4px oklch(64% 0.14 85); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Cancel, secondary actions. Mono-caps label so the action reads as a stamp, not a CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: oklch(24% 0.014 240); font-family: 'Inter Tight', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(85% 0.012 140); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(92% 0.012 140); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(95% 0.008 145), 0 0 0 4px oklch(64% 0.14 85); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Title, kind, settings field. The persistent hairline shadow reads as a printed underline, not a drop shadow.
components.css: .ds-input-text { display: block; width: 100%; background: oklch(92% 0.012 140); color: oklch(24% 0.014 240); font-family: 'Inter Tight', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.65; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid oklch(85% 0.012 140); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 oklch(85% 0.012 140 / 0.6); transition: box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-input-text::placeholder { color: oklch(48% 0.018 200); opacity: 0.7; } .ds-input-text:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(95% 0.008 145), 0 0 0 4px oklch(64% 0.14 85); }

components.name: Markdown Textarea
components.description: Editing markdown reads as editing a code file. Mono typography, paper-warm bg, hairline tactile underline.
components.css: .ds-input-textarea { display: block; width: 100%; resize: vertical; background: oklch(92% 0.012 140); color: oklch(24% 0.014 240); font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.65; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(85% 0.012 140); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 oklch(85% 0.012 140 / 0.6); transition: box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-input-textarea:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(95% 0.008 145), 0 0 0 4px oklch(64% 0.14 85); }

components.name: Dashboard List Row
components.description: One doc in the operator's recent list. Title (sans, semibold) + date (mono, tabular nums). No kind chrome.
components.html: • Notes on the patch endpointApr 27, 2026
components.css: .ds-list-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 14px; padding: 11px 14px; background: oklch(92% 0.012 140); border: 1px solid oklch(85% 0.012 140); border-radius: 4px; align-items: baseline; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); list-style: none; } .ds-list-row:hover { background: oklch(89% 0.014 140); } .ds-list-row__title { font-family: 'Inter Tight', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(24% 0.014 240); } .ds-list-row__date { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(48% 0.018 200); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-feature-settings: 'tnum'; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Code Block (Signature)
components.description: The signature component. 2px ochre leading rule on the left edge. Shiki renders syntax tokens; brand contributes only the container chrome.
components.css: .ds-code { background: oklch(92% 0.012 140); border-left: 2px solid oklch(64% 0.14 85); border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; overflow: hidden; margin: 24px 0; } .ds-code__pre { margin: 0; padding: 16px 20px; overflow-x: auto; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(24% 0.014 240); } .ds-code__pre code { background: transparent; padding: 0; font-family: inherit; font-size: inherit; color: inherit; } .ds-code ::selection { background: oklch(64% 0.14 85 / 0.22); color: inherit; }

components.name: Search Bar (Operator Topbar)
components.description: Operator dashboard top row. Click opens the cmd-palette. ⌘K kbd indicator on the right.
components.html: ⌘ K
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; background: oklch(92% 0.012 140); border: 1px solid oklch(85% 0.012 140); border-radius: 8px; cursor: text; } .ds-search__icon { color: oklch(48% 0.018 200); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-search__input { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none; font-family: 'Inter Tight', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(24% 0.014 240); } .ds-search__input::placeholder { color: oklch(48% 0.018 200); opacity: 0.7; } .ds-search__kbd { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid oklch(85% 0.012 140); border-radius: 4px; color: oklch(48% 0.018 200); }

narrative.overview: md is a share tool. Recipients land on a /v/<slug> link cold — usually from a DM or chat — read the doc, and close the tab. The interface gets out of their way. A small watermark in the corner of every surface names the publisher (md) without claiming the page; clicking it reveals a tooltip with the few actions the reader needs (raw view, copy link, width toggle). The doc dominates; md is the bug in the corner that says 'this came from a place that cares about typography.' The system rejects four neighbors that share its zip code: SaaS landing-page tropes, Notion / Medium clones, over-designed personal portfolios, and the generic dev-tool category reflex. The Linear / Raycast lane is borrowed for discipline — restraint, scale-driven hierarchy, mono micro-type — not for its palette. Both themes get equal craft; light is fog cream, dark is dark fog with paper-warm fg, asymmetric rather than inverted.
keyCharacteristics: Single-family sans (Inter Tight, weight-driven) for everything; mono (Geist Mono) only for code and chrome micro-type.
Tinted neutrals never #fff or #000 or zero-chroma; warm fog cream + ink in light, dark fog + paper-warm fg in dark.
One accent color, ochre, used on ≤ 5% of any screen: focus, link-on-hover, code-block leading rule, watermark glyph, selection.
Tactile flat: depth via tonal layering and stateful shadows; no decorative shadows, no glassmorphism.
The watermark is the universal nav. 32px corner glyph, click-to-reveal tooltip, W1 underline-draw on hover.
Cmd-palette (⌘K) is the eventual nav-at-scale; the watermark tooltip absorbs operator nav until it ships.

rules.name: The Watermark Color Rule
rules.body: Ochre is the only saturated color. ≤ 5% of any rendered surface. If a design wants color to do work, the answer is type weight + tonal layering, not a second accent.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black-Or-White Rule
rules.body: Never #000, #fff, or zero-chroma neutrals. Every neutral tinted toward warm hue 140–220.

rules.name: The Asymmetric Theme Rule
rules.body: Light and dark are separate designed atmospheres, not inverted neutrals.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: One sans (Inter Tight) carries display through body. Mono (Geist Mono) is reserved for code and chrome micro-type.

rules.name: The 1.4-Ratio Rule
rules.body: Step ratio between hierarchy levels ≥ 1.25, with display ≥ 1.4 above headline.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numerals Rule
rules.body: Dates, byte counts, slug fragments use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows reserved for input tactility, button press, focus, and floating-overlay softness.

rules.name: The Focus-Has-Color Rule
rules.body: Focus is the only chrome state where the ochre accent appears at rest.

dos: Do use Inter Tight across display, headline, title, body, label.
Do reserve mono (Geist Mono) for code and chrome micro-type. Tabular numerics on every numeric column.
Do use OKLCH for every color value. Tint every neutral toward warm hue 140–220.
Do reserve ochre for focus, link-on-hover, code-block leading rule, watermark glyph, selection. ≤ 5% of any surface.
Do treat light and dark as separate designed atmospheres.
Do make the code block a signature: ochre leading rule, paper-warm ground, careful padding.
Do vary spacing between dashboard, view page, settings, and forms.
Do lead each section with real weight contrast (H1 700 ≥ 1.4× H2 600).
Do put aria-label on every icon-only button. Focus-ring clears all surfaces in both themes.
donts: Don't use Inter, Geist Sans, or any Vercel-stack default font.
Don't use zinc-50/100/900/950 in new code.
Don't use SaaS landing-page tropes (hero-metric, gradient accents, identical card grids, glassmorphism).
Don't use Notion / Medium clone signals (big serif H1, blockquote-heavy stylings, narrow capsule chrome).
Don't use over-designed personal portfolio tells (gradient text, scroll-jacking, mouse-trail effects).
Don't use border-left / border-right > 1px as a colored stripe (one exception: 2px ochre code-block leading rule).
Don't use scale() / bounce / elastic easing.
Don't nest cards inside cards. Don't wrap every section in a container.
Don't add a second accent color.
Don't use em dashes in UI copy. No --.
Don't change a button's border on focus; the focus-ring carries the state.
Don't animate layout properties; transform / opacity only.
Don't show a header on the unauthed /v/<slug> reader page.
Don't override Shiki syntax token colors with brand colors.
